facts.statement: Free Realms servers were taken offline on the evening of July 28, 2010 for a small update, with downtime starting sometime after 9pm PDT.
facts.quote: The servers will be unavailable sometime after 9pm PDT for 2-4 hours.

facts.statement: The July 28, 2010 maintenance was expected to last 2 to 4 hours, with servers restored after testing was completed.
facts.quote: We will bring everything back online as soon as we have completed testing.

article_summaries.title: Maintenance Notice - July 28th, 2010
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com notice announcing that the servers would go offline on the evening of July 28, 2010 for a small update. The page gives no patch contents, only the downtime window and that the game would return once testing was complete.
